title: Sinking Fund (Future Value Annuity)
body:
A company needs to replace a machine in 6 years' time. The replacement cost is estimated at R450 000.

The company sets up a sinking fund that earns 9% per annum, compounded monthly.

Calculate the monthly payment that must be made into the sinking fund.

Future Value Annuity Formula: $F = x \cdot \frac{(1+i)^n - 1}{i}$
